name: SDF BSP Tree Construction
definition: A method to generate a Signed Distance Field (SDF) from a triangle mesh by recursively subdividing space into two sets using dividing hyperplanes, allowing ray traversal to calculate the distance to the nearest point on the surface.
summary: SDF BSP Tree Construction generates a Signed Distance Field from triangle meshes by recursively partitioning space, offering perfect accuracy but suffering from poor performance due to sequential CPU construction and GPU-unfriendly branching.
